newsitem.title: USA: Comforce knows no reason for recent shr drop.
newsitem.headline: Comforce knows no reason for recent shr drop.

text.p: COMFORCE said Wednesday it knows of no reason why the company's common stock should have declined in recent weeks.
The stock was down 1-1/2 at 11-5/8 in mid-afternoon trading.

The company said its fundamentals and business prospects remain strong and unchanged. The company said it recently held its first annual meeting during which it posted positive quarterly results, announced the closing of two acquisitions and announced a definitive purchase agreement with a third acquisition candidate.
